title: [hits]: Apply `transformData.allItems` even if no `template.allItems`
body:
Currently, the `transformData.allItems` method is only applied when a `templates.allItems` template is defined. What if I want to filter the list of results returned but still use the default rendering (and thus only want to use the `templates.item` property)?

This can be used for example to dedupe elements returned by the API in more custom ways, or merge elements together. Currently this can only be achieved by defining a `templates.allItems` that only reproduce the default behavior.

I suggest we always apply `transformData.allItems` to the list of returned hits, even if no `allItems` template is defined. Then, each of the resulting hit will be normally passed to the `transformData.item` methods.

This does not change the fact that the `item` and `allItems` templates are mutually exclusive, just the fact the that `allItems` `transformData` is always called.

Thoughts? I can take care of the PR.
